segments.text: The personal protective equipment, PPE, worn by actors in this video, was selected based
segments.zh: 本视频中演员所穿戴的个人防护装备（PPE），是根据

segments.text: on a risk assessment of the chemicals used in the experiment, and conditions simulated
segments.zh: 对实验所用化学品以及活动中模拟的条件进行的风险评估

segments.text: in the activity.
segments.zh: 来选择的。

segments.text: In scenes where the presenter did not wear PPE while in the lab, all chemicals were removed
segments.zh: 在主持人于实验室内未穿戴个人防护装备的镜头中，所有化学品都已移走，

segments.text: to eliminate chemical hazards.
segments.zh: 以消除化学危害。

segments.text: Hi, welcome to Chemistry Lab.
segments.zh: 你好，欢迎来到化学实验室。

segments.text: If you're a college student, you may have already taken a high school chemistry course
segments.zh: 如果你是大学生，你可能已经上过高中化学课，

segments.text: and learned some rules of lab safety along the way.
segments.zh: 并在学习过程中了解了一些实验室安全规则。

segments.text: As you begin college classes, you'll probably hear some of the same rules you learned in
segments.zh: 开始上大学课程后，你可能会听到一些和你在

segments.text: high school.
segments.zh: 高中学过的相同的规则。

segments.text: In this video series, our goal is to build on those rules, but go a bit further.
segments.zh: 在这个系列视频中，我们的目标是在这些规则的基础上更进一步。

segments.text: We'll establish basic principles of lab safety that you can use in any new situation.
segments.zh: 我们将建立实验室安全的基本原则，让你在任何新情况下都能运用。

segments.text: As you move through chemistry classes, you'll encounter many lab situations where general
segments.zh: 随着你学习各门化学课程，你会遇到许多实验室情境，其中通用的

segments.text: rules need some adjustment based on risk management.
segments.zh: 规则需要根据风险管理做出一些调整。

segments.text: The steps for managing risks can easily be remembered using the acronym RAMP.
segments.zh: 管理风险的步骤可以用首字母缩写 RAMP 轻松记住。

segments.text: RAMP stands for Recognize Hazards, Assess the Risk, Minimize the Risk, Prepare for Emergencies.
segments.zh: RAMP 代表：识别危害、评估风险、最小化风险、为紧急情况做准备。

segments.text: Let's briefly take a look at each one.
segments.zh: 我们来简要看看每一项。

segments.text: The first step is to recognize hazards.
segments.zh: 第一步是识别危害。

segments.text: Simply put, a hazard is something that can harm you.
segments.zh: 简单地说，危害就是可能伤害你的东西。

segments.text: In the Chemistry Lab, chemicals are an important source of hazards, but hazards can also arise
segments.zh: 在化学实验室里，化学品是危害的重要来源，但危害也可能来自

segments.text: from equipment and procedures.
segments.zh: 设备和操作程序。

segments.text: Sulfuric acid, a strong acid, is an example of a hazard.
segments.zh: 硫酸是一种强酸，就是危害的一个例子。

segments.text: Sulfuric acid is useful because it reacts with many other chemicals.
segments.zh: 硫酸很有用，因为它能与许多其他化学品发生反应。

segments.text: But it will also react with your skin, causing a chemical burn.
segments.zh: 但它也会与你的皮肤发生反应，造成化学灼伤。

segments.text: The property that makes it useful also creates the hazard.
segments.zh: 使它有用的性质同时也造成了危害。

segments.text: In some experiments, it may be the procedure that is hazardous.
segments.zh: 在某些实验中，危险的可能是操作程序本身。

segments.text: If a solution needs to be heated, the source of heat creates the hazard.
segments.zh: 如果溶液需要加热，热源就会带来危害。

segments.text: This is especially true if one of the chemical reagents is flammable.
segments.zh: 如果其中一种化学试剂是易燃的，情况尤其如此。

segments.text: Step two of RAMP is about assessing risk.
segments.zh: RAMP 的第二步是评估风险。

segments.text: Risk is the chance of being harmed by a hazard.
segments.zh: 风险是被某种危害伤害的可能性。

segments.text: Even if a chemical is hazardous, it doesn't necessarily present a significant risk.
segments.zh: 即使一种化学品是危险的，它也不一定会带来重大风险。

segments.text: Risk is a combination of both the severity of hazard and the likelihood of exposure.
segments.zh: 风险是危害严重程度和暴露可能性两者的结合。

segments.text: You can think of it like this.
segments.zh: 你可以这样理解：

segments.text: Risk equals severity of hazard times the likelihood of exposure.
segments.zh: 风险等于危害严重程度乘以暴露的可能性。

segments.text: For example, a solution with a high concentration of nitric acid is very hazardous since it
segments.zh: 例如，高浓度的硝酸溶液非常危险，因为它

segments.text: is both a strong acid and a good oxidizing agent.
segments.zh: 既是强酸，又是很强的氧化剂。

segments.text: It's easy to control one drop, and if it got on your skin, it could be easily washed
segments.zh: 一滴是很容易控制的，如果滴到皮肤上，也很容易冲洗

segments.text: off.
segments.zh: 干净。

segments.text: On the other hand, if you spill 50 milliliters of the solution on your leg, you get a lot
segments.zh: 另一方面，如果你把 50 毫升这种溶液洒在腿上，你就会受到大量

segments.text: of exposure, and it could cause significant damage.
segments.zh: 暴露，可能造成严重伤害。

segments.text: You can see that the amount of the acid in the way it's used affects the level of risk.
segments.zh: 你可以看到，酸的用量和使用方式会影响风险的高低。

segments.text: Another example would be the use of a liquid like ethyl ether where the vapor is unsafe
segments.zh: 另一个例子是使用像乙醚这样的液体，它的蒸气吸入

segments.text: to breathe.
segments.zh: 是不安全的。

segments.text: Using this in the open part of the lab presents significant risk.
segments.zh: 在实验室的开放区域使用它会带来重大风险。

segments.text: Using it in a chemical hood is much safer since the likelihood of inhalation is greatly
segments.zh: 在化学通风柜中使用就安全得多，因为吸入的可能性大大

segments.text: reduced.
segments.zh: 降低了。

segments.text: We'll dig deeper into assessing risk in another video, but for now, just remember
segments.zh: 我们会在另一个视频中深入探讨风险评估，但现在只要记住：

segments.text: all experiments pose some risk, and most experiments can be done safely if the risk
segments.zh: 所有实验都存在一定风险，而如果把风险降低到可接受的水平，

segments.text: is reduced to acceptable levels.
segments.zh: 大多数实验都可以安全进行。

segments.text: The third step in RAMP is to minimize risk from the hazards.
segments.zh: RAMP 的第三步是将危害带来的风险降到最低。

segments.text: This is the origin of many familiar lab rules.
segments.zh: 许多大家熟悉的实验室规则就源于此。

segments.text: For example, working in a chemical hood to avoid breathing hazardous gases and vapors,
segments.zh: 例如，在化学通风柜中操作，以避免吸入有害气体和蒸气；

segments.text: wearing eye protection to avoid any possibility of corrosive substances damaging sensitive
segments.zh: 佩戴眼部防护用品，以避免腐蚀性物质损伤敏感的

segments.text: eye tissue, and wearing gloves and or a lab coat when a procedure may expose skin to
segments.zh: 眼部组织；当操作可能使皮肤受到潜在伤害时，

segments.text: potential injury.
segments.zh: 戴手套和／或穿实验服。

segments.text: Here are some other questions you can ask to help minimize exposure.
segments.zh: 下面是另外一些可以帮助你尽量减少暴露的问题。

segments.text: Can you use a less hazardous chemical in place of a more hazardous one?
segments.zh: 能否用危险性较低的化学品代替危险性较高的？

segments.text: Can you use lower concentrations of chemicals?
segments.zh: 能否使用较低浓度的化学品？

segments.text: Can you run a reaction with smaller amounts of chemicals?
segments.zh: 能否用较少量的化学品进行反应？

segments.text: Can you lower the temperature to reduce the risk of burns?
segments.zh: 能否降低温度以减少烫伤的风险？

segments.text: It's not possible to remove all risk, but risk can and should always be minimized.
segments.zh: 不可能消除所有风险，但风险可以而且应该始终降到最低。

segments.text: Check out the other two videos in this series that discuss minimizing risk more thoroughly.
segments.zh: 请观看本系列中更深入讨论风险最小化的另外两个视频。

segments.text: The final step in RAMP is to prepare for emergencies.
segments.zh: RAMP 的最后一步是为紧急情况做准备。

segments.text: If something goes wrong, are you prepared?
segments.zh: 如果出了问题，你准备好了吗？

segments.text: Do you know how to handle a fire or respond to a spill?
segments.zh: 你知道如何处理火灾或应对泄漏吗？

segments.text: We go over these scenarios in more detail in other videos, but just remember that you
segments.zh: 我们会在其他视频中更详细地讲解这些情况，但请记住，你

segments.text: should consciously think about what might go wrong in an experiment and then be ready
segments.zh: 应该有意识地思考实验中可能出什么问题，然后做好

segments.text: to respond.
segments.zh: 应对的准备。

segments.text: The safety knowledge and skills that you learn in your chemistry classes are greatly influenced
segments.zh: 你在化学课上学到的安全知识和技能，在很大程度上受到

segments.text: by the culture of your institution.
segments.zh: 你所在机构文化的影响。

segments.text: As you start working in the lab, you should think about how you can contribute to this
segments.zh: 当你开始在实验室工作时，你应该思考如何为这种

segments.text: culture.
segments.zh: 文化做出贡献。

segments.text: A positive culture of safety requires you to do your part.
segments.zh: 积极的安全文化需要你尽到自己的一份责任。

segments.text: This starts with the right attitude and ethics, value safety, work safely, don't engage in
segments.zh: 这首先要有正确的态度和道德观：重视安全，安全地工作，不从事

segments.text: risky behavior, promote safety, and accept responsibility for safety.
segments.zh: 危险行为，促进安全，并承担安全责任。

segments.text: Everyone using chemicals in their career needs the right knowledge, skills, and attitudes
segments.zh: 每个在职业中使用化学品的人，都需要具备正确的知识、技能和态度，

segments.text: to work safely in the lab.
segments.zh: 才能在实验室安全地工作。

segments.text: Keep safety at the forefront in your chemistry and science education and it will serve
segments.zh: 在你的化学和科学学习中始终把安全放在首位，它会让你

segments.text: you well.
segments.zh: 受益匪浅。

segments.text: As you can see, there's a lot more to learn about safety than just following rules.
segments.zh: 正如你所看到的，关于安全要学的远不止遵守规则。

segments.text: What are the hazards an experiment can present?
segments.zh: 一个实验可能存在哪些危害？

segments.text: How do we learn about those hazards?
segments.zh: 我们如何了解这些危害？

segments.text: How do we decide which hazards really present some risks to you and how serious is the risk?
segments.zh: 我们如何判断哪些危害真正对你构成风险，以及风险有多严重？

segments.text: For a deeper dive into these topics, be sure to check out the other five videos in this
segments.zh: 想更深入地了解这些主题，一定要看看本系列的其他五个

segments.text: series.
segments.zh: 视频。

segments.text: You can find them by clicking here, checking out the links in the description, or visiting
segments.zh: 你可以点击这里、查看描述中的链接，或访问

segments.text: acs.org slash safety videos.
segments.zh: acs.org/safetyvideos 找到它们。

segments.text: Thanks for watching!
segments.zh: 感谢观看！
